First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 2:00 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Kids’ pace. It’s no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That’s the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Danny’s Cycles Darien Kids’ Ride group ride

Danny’s Cycles Darien Kids’ Ride is a social group ride in Darien, CT. It rolls every Sunday at 2:00 pm from Danny’s Cycles Darien.

A Sunday afternoon skills ride for kids from the Darien shop. All skill levels. Closed-toed shoes and long pants or knee protection required. Fair-weather only.
